spectrum_type: DUV Raman PDS region-level representative spectrum
data_level: PDS processed RRS laser-normalized region spectrum
measurement_conditions: In-situ SHERLOC deep-UV Raman; PDS processed RRS product; laser-normalized spectra in public PDS4 CSV table.
label_basis: Weak scan-level candidate label from Corpolongo et al. (2023); not a point-level mineral assignment. Use only for exploratory semi-supervised/domain-adaptation analyses unless a point-label workbook is supplied.
reference: Corpolongo, A., et al. (2023). SHERLOC Raman mineral class detections of the Mars 2020 crater floor campaign. Journal of Geophysical Research: Planets, 128, e2022JE007455.
source_note: Montpezat HDR_500_1: silicate, carbonate, and perchlorate-or-phosphate signatures were reported; 17 single spectra displayed silicate signatures, four of them high-confidence; three carbonate and three perchlorate/phosphate spectra were observed.
preprocessing_planned: Mask non-SHERLOC Raman region below 800 cm-1; baseline correction; max-intensity normalization; first derivative channel for MST.
recommended_action: Do not include in the default closed-set fine-tuning table; add to training only after point-level labels are independently curated.
paper_context: The paper reports scan-level detections and representative mean spectra, not a point-level mineral-label table for this target.
pds_table_names: LASER-NORMALIZED SPECTRA REGION 1|LASER-NORMALIZED SPECTRA REGION 2|LASER-NORMALIZED SPECTRA REGION 3|WAVELENGTH NM
